gate_type: ACCELERATED IMPLEMENTATION GATE — Migrate TIPA Workspace / ASSY Federation onto G1–G4 (G5)
objective: Migrate the existing TIPA ASSY multi-context runtime into the vNext structural/composition foundation (G1 Workspace/Scope + G4 participant/coordinator seams) while preserving all existing ASSY domain behavior. Target containment: Workspace 'TIPA' -> container-only Scope 'ASSY' -> six executable-capable Scopes ASSY-SL01..ASSY-SL06. Prove the same existing AssyLineRuntime can remain the runtime truth in both standalone and federated hosting; do not fork or rewrite domain logic; do not invent a new synchronization policy; do not start G6+.
explicit_non_objectives: No G7 run-control UI/API, replay orchestration, restart policy
No G9 semantic binding / PIM resolver
No new synchronization policy hidden inside the migration
No fractional dwell/index or ASSY time-semantics rewrite to satisfy arbitrary coordinator targets
No AssyLineRuntime rewrite or domain behavior retyping
No treating the ASSY container scope as executable
No turning demo-specific identity/policy into generic platform truth
forbidden_actions: Rewrite AssyLineRuntime or retype its domain behavior
Invent fractional dwell/index or a hidden time rewrite to satisfy coordinator targets
Define a new cross-sub-line synchronization policy
Treat ASSY container scope as executable
Turn TIPA demo identity/policy into generic platform truth
stop_conditions: Adapter requires modifying/retyping AssyLineRuntime domain behavior
Arbitrary coordinator target requires fractional dwell/index or hidden time rewrite
Six sub-lines cannot participate safely without defining a new synchronization policy
Safe solution requires treating the ASSY container scope as executable
Existing G1-G4 contracts must be broken
Demo-specific identity/policy must become generic platform truth
Scope expands into G6 UI, G7 run-control/replay, G8+, G9 semantic binding, or G10 SH-WTP

acceptance_criteria.description: Exact TIPA -> ASSY -> six sub-line hierarchy resolves through G1 authority
ASSY is container-only and cannot be registered as a participant
Six sub-lines executable-capable with canonical structural paths
Six adapters wrap six existing AssyLineRuntime instances without rewriting them
Adapter current_time_s equals wrapped runtime simulation time
Representative standalone vs federated execution equivalent for supported shared boundaries
Identity drift/mismatch fails closed through existing G4 rules
Full ASSY regression oracle remains green
No G6+ implementation appears; no AssyLineRuntime rewrite
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
